The vivid, juicy nose opens with notes of dried berries and a light shade of eucalyptus, moving into a rich bouquet of blueberry jam, ripe cherry, delicate plum marmalade and juicy black currant. In the background, graceful nuances of thyme and a soft vanilla shade.

bruschettas with roast beef, cold roast beef with raspberry sauce,
rack of lamb with rosemary, beef tenderloin with lingonberry sauce, beef cheeks slow-braised in wine, mature aged cheeses.
